audience: finance teams that check customer and supplier VAT numbers before they invoice

useCases.title: Check a VAT number against the government register
useCases.text: Validate a VAT number and read whether the company is active and VAT-registered. Each check creates a validation record and uses one hit of the plan.

useCases.title: Review past VAT checks for a supplier
useCases.text: List past VAT validations, newest first, and filter them by number or date. Open one to read its register result and any error code.

useCases.title: Look up the VAT rate for a country or IP address
useCases.text: List standard and reduced VAT rates by country, including rates for digital products. Or get the rate for the country of an IP address.

useCases.title: Check plan hit usage before a batch of checks
useCases.text: Read the hits used this month and the plan capacity. Check them before you run a batch of VAT validations.
